svg.title: Figure24 Context Assembly and Policy Decision Model
svg.desc: NEW-shot2play Protocol Suite Version 2.0. Context intake, validation, assembly, policy evaluation, authorization decision, enforcement, conditional handling, reauthentication, reentitlement, reauthorization, and audit trace.
svg.text: Figure24 Context Assembly and Policy Decision Model
Validated Security Context → Policy Evaluation → Authorization Decision → Enforcement
Policy → Evaluation → Decision → Audit provides deterministic traceability.
Entitlement State Change · Policy Version Change · Resource Change · Action Change
Transaction State Change · Decision Expiration · Additional Assurance Requirement
A material context change SHALL NOT silently preserve a previous authorization decision.
A failure at any security boundary SHALL NOT silently degrade into an allow result.
Transaction ID · Evaluation ID · Policy ID / Version · Decision ID · Entitlement ID · Authentication ID · Event ID
These references SHALL permit reconstruction of the policy-to-decision processing path.
